description: Local AI launcher for installing and managing AI applications, models, runtimes, and dependencies from scripts.

script: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Pinokio NSIS uninstaller was not found in the Scoop version directory.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw ('Pinokio uninstaller exited with code {0}.' -f $process.ExitCode) }

notes: Nonportable: runs the official Electron Builder NSIS installer silently in the Scoop version directory and registers the pinokio:// protocol and Windows shortcuts. The downloaded setup is named Pinokio-Setup.exe so Scoop cleanup cannot delete the installed Pinokio.exe.
Pinokio stores downloaded scripts, environments, and binaries under %USERPROFILE%\pinokio by default. This data is separate from the Scoop application directory and remains after uninstall.
